motifs.name: misty_distant_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the large upper mountain range: the central ochre peak and adjoining ridges, faint blue-gray left peaks, and surrounding pale mist bands. Exclude all calligraphy and red seals above it.
must_preserve: soft tan and ochre washes on the main peak
faint contour lines defining ridges
irregular white mist gaps and cloud-like edges crossing the mountain
subtle blue-gray silhouettes of receding peaks at left
dry-brush texture and pale erosion-like streaks on the slopes

motifs.name: left_waterfall_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the left middle cliff mass with rounded ochre rocks, the narrow white waterfall dropping through the ravine, and the pale water pool at its base. Avoid neighboring pavilion roofs and distant temple elements.
must_preserve: thin white vertical waterfall channel
rounded layered rock contours in light brown and green washes
small dark cave-like opening near the pool
soft misty water edge at the base
fine reddish-brown contour strokes on the cliff faces

motifs.name: pine_temple_hillside
motifs.description: Isolate the temple and pagoda group set into the right hillside, including the stepped red-roofed pagoda, partial hall roofs, and the vertical pine avenue rising along the slope. Exclude the nearby red seal on the hill.
must_preserve: stacked pagoda roof geometry with red accents
glimpsed red and gray tiled roofs behind trees
slender dark pine trunks arranged in a diagonal line
needle-like pine foliage strokes
green hillside wash and fine slope contouring

motifs.name: central_garden_pavilions
motifs.description: Isolate the main garden architecture in the middle: connected white-walled pavilions with gray tiled roofs, open veranda, interior furnishings and tiny figures, plus the immediate courtyard edge. Do not include the large right scholar rock cluster except where it touches the architecture.
must_preserve: precise roof tile striping and roof angles
white wall planes with thin ink outlines
open colonnade and veranda posts
tiny interior figures and red furniture accents
surrounding garden shrubs and pale wash transitions around the buildings

motifs.name: bottom_gate_fence_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the lower garden entrance area: the small open gate pavilion, diagonal fence or wall, foreground pines and bare trees, and low shrubs along the bottom edge. Exclude the red seal at the lower left border.
must_preserve: small roofed gate with open doorway and tiled roof lines
diagonal lattice fence/wall pattern
slender pine trunks with dark needle clusters
bare winter-branch linework
low green shrubs and pale ground wash around the entrance
